video_title: Keyshawn Johnson Takes Brock Purdy Over Josh Allen

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's perspective on the UCLA football team's performance
quotes.excerpt: Had they not lost to Wisconsin, I'm all in. I'm cardinal and gold out.
quotes.quote: Had they not lost to Wisconsin, I'm all in. I'm cardinal and gold out. I'm going to look like an 80-year-old alumni, walking around here with the gear on. But I just said, you know what, I cannot put myself in that stadium knowing good and damn well that we're going to come away with a L. I just know we are. And if we don't, okay, good for us. But we got to go to Indiana next and we got to play the cross-town stinking Bruins.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson on the personal nature of the Seahawks-Chiefs game
quotes.excerpt: It was personal, because you don't want him coming back into his building and get down on you.
quotes.quote: It was personal, because you don't want him coming back into his building and get down on you. He's been getting down on the whole league. K9 has been doing his thing, but as a former teammate, you're like, no, I went through that. I went through that when I left the Jets and they came to Tampa for the first time, and I played against them. Their mission, they weren't going to let me do nothing. I'd line up, they'd line up, and another dude, I'm like, come on man, you're tripping. We're laughing the whole time, but I knew what it was. They were not, if anybody was going to beat them, it wasn't going to be me.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson on the Indianapolis Colts needing a roster rebuild
quotes.excerpt: The Indianapolis Colts, they should be up for sale, not the team, but the players.
quotes.quote: The Indianapolis Colts, they should be up for sale, not the team, but the players. They should be all ready to go. Jonathan Taylor should be the next dude gone, Matt, Tyler, if somebody, if they can move him. You know what I'm saying? They should just start all over again.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's take on the Kansas City Chiefs' schedule strength
quotes.excerpt: You play the teams that are in front of you. That's what you do.
quotes.quote: You play the teams that are in front of you. That's what you do. And then you count up the wins at the end and see where you at. Simple. It's not, it's not hard, Matt. At the end of the day, you just, you take care of your business because week one they played Denver and they blew Denver out. And now Denver's a strong team again, you know, and so, you start looking at that, you know, the Indianapolis Colt game was a good game for them. The Colts kind of fell apart, but that particular game was good.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson on his final season with the Carolina Panthers
quotes.excerpt: I was a free agent and I only wanted to play one more year.
quotes.quote: I was a free agent and I only wanted to play one more year. So I went to Carolina because we had Steve Smith and Jake Delhomme and DeShaun Foster, UCLA guy, Julius Peppers. Like we had a squad. They had just lost the year before to Seattle in the NFC Championship game and Smitty was over there getting handcuffed. They had everybody on it, right? So I'm like, man, I'm going, I'm taking my black ass to Carolina. Soon as I get there, I'm like, cool, I could be robbing. I don't want to really play no more. I'm just going to, you know, do what I need to do. Leave some pressure. Soon as we get a look up, Smitty then got hurt the week one of the season. Smitty hurt his foot too that year, right? Then he break his foot. But we had DeAngelo Williams we had drafted from Memphis. So I remember trade camp. Smitty got hurt and we was getting ready to play DeAngelo Hall in Atlanta. First thing I said to myself is, damn, I got to go out here, play against this young dude, he going to be talking the entire game and I don't feel like getting into a war of words. Now all of a sudden I got to become Batman again, when I just wanted to be robbing and riding low for the ride.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's assessment of Kyler Murray and the Cardinals
quotes.excerpt: Kyler Murray, whatever. I mean, that's really what it is.
quotes.quote: Kyler Murray, whatever. I mean, that's really what it is. I personally, when he went out game one with the injury and Carson Wentz took over, that was the best offensive output of the season as far as I'm concerned.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's top five NFL wide receivers
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to go Jamarr Chase one, I'm going to go JSN two, I'm going to go Puka three.
quotes.quote: I'm going to go Jamarr Chase one, I'm going to go JSN two, I'm going to go Puka three. That's my three receivers. If you said right now, I need three, those would be my three. Amon-Ra St. Brown will be in there somewhere four, but I can do the same things with those three dudes that I can do with Amon-Ra. Amon-Ra can't do what those three dudes can do. So they're more interchangeable for me. You know what I mean? JSN obviously right now is having an amazing year. And we see obviously we know Chase. And then Puka just, you know, a aggressive dog.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson on the Denver Broncos' late-game decision-making
quotes.excerpt: They backed up with a minute and some change to go in the fourth quarter.
quotes.quote: They backed up with a minute and some change to go in the fourth quarter, tied 17-17 on their own 20-yard line, maybe 22-yard line. They went for it on fourth and two. It wasn't a, it wasn't a short two either. It might have really been fourth and three. Soon as he did it, the first thing everybody that I was around and up, what the fuck are you doing? Went for it, didn't get it. Gave Green Bay the ball back. Green Bay three and out. Kicked the field goal, missed it. That close. That close. I don't know what Dan Campbell will do. And I meant to text Dan after the game, I just didn't. I wanted to, I wanted to text him like, what the fuck you doing?

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson on the impact of international travel on NFL teams
quotes.excerpt: Depends on the team you with, right? Some teams go over early, some teams.
quotes.quote: Depends on the team you with, right? Some teams go over early, some teams. You saw what the Rams did, they went over there like 24 hours where San Francisco said we going over for four weeks. We going to sit over there. So it just depends on the organization. Now I personally wouldn't want to be playing 10 games or eight games or seven games in an international country. No, I would not. Would not at all, because of the time change and the travel. A lot of times it's also mental, right? Where you're traveling so much, you're there now you're like, man, I just want to get this over with. So you're not, players probably aren't as focused, because they just trying to get in and get out.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's experience playing in Tokyo
quotes.excerpt: When I was with Tampa Bay, we played the Jets in Tokyo. We flew from Tampa to Tokyo.
quotes.quote: When I was with Tampa Bay, we played the Jets in Tokyo. We flew from Tampa to Tokyo. Inside the stadium though, it was like European basketball arena. Crazy. Man, everybody in there smoking. They had us inside the, they had us inside the Tokyo Dome, it was like a cloud, man. Wow. Imagine that though. You know, because NFL players, you out of all NFL players, man, you might got man, I don't even know the number, .1% may have light up a cigarette or something. Maybe less than that. I couldn't even tell you, but nobody's smoking. Imagine being in that environment. Man, it was disgusting. And we was sitting in the middle of the Tokyo Dome while they were smoking playing. That shit was wild.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson on the viability of international NFL games
quotes.excerpt: One game is cool. There's nothing wrong with going over there one game.
quotes.quote: I mean, one game is cool. There's nothing wrong with going over there one game. Maybe even two games is cool. But to, to put your foot down in a, in a foreign land and foreign country internationally and want players to play eight games over there, nine games over there and travel is going to be crazy. Think about what if you had a game in London and you playing in London and you got another one in Tokyo. I mean, imagine that travel. You know, that's just, it's a lot.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's top three wide receivers
quotes.excerpt: So I'm going to say Jamarr Chase one, I'm going to say JSN two, I'm going to say Amari St. Brown.
quotes.quote: So I'm going to say Jamarr Chase one, I'm going to say JSN two, I'm going to say Amari St. Brown. I'm missing some people already off the top of my head. JSN, Chase, Amari. Does Jefferson get put in? Oh, Jefferson. Okay. Somebody I'm missing. Puka. So here's, here's how I would, this is my order, if I, if I give an order. I'm going to go Chase one, I'm going to go JSN two, I'm going to go Puka three. That's my three receivers. If you said right now, I need three, those would be my three.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's ideal NFL quarterback and tight end
quotes.excerpt: It would be probably Patrick Mahomes, then I'll take Brock Purdy.
quotes.quote: It would be probably Patrick Mahomes, then I'll take Brock Purdy. I mean, look, people going to say, you're crazy because of Josh Allen. That's cool. But Josh Allen like to give it to the other team too much for me. He like to throw it to the other color. He likes to hold it more too. And then I don't need you running around. I got a running back for a reason.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson on the Kansas City Chiefs' matchup against the Broncos
quotes.excerpt: Can the Chiefs bounce back? They took care of the Broncos in week one.
quotes.quote: Can the Chiefs bounce back? They took care of the Broncos in week one. The Broncos are mercenaries at home. They get down at home for whatever reason. They like to win at home. The Chiefs going in there, and they still going to be undermanned at the receiver position where I believe the Broncos will be a full strength.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's prediction for Ravens vs. Bills
quotes.excerpt: I think Lamar's coming back. I would probably lean, I would probably lean on the Ravens with Lamar.
quotes.quote: I think Lamar's coming back. I would probably lean, I would probably lean on the Ravens with Lamar. No Lamar, I'm Bills.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's take on the Lions' defense and offense
quotes.excerpt: I like the Lions, man. Their defense is good enough to go up against Kyler Murray.
quotes.quote: I like the Lions, man. Their defense is good enough to go up against Kyler Murray, but I like the Lions' offense. As long as Dan Campbell don't do something goofy, man. Because he's known to, you know, do something goofy.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's pick for the Browns vs. Steelers game
quotes.excerpt: I'm taking the Steelers. At home, what happened in them a couple weeks ago with the Browns.
quotes.quote: I'm taking the Steelers. At home, what happened in them a couple weeks ago with the Browns, that's not going to happen. You're not going to sweep a team in your division, especially in this division. And Aaron Rodgers is playing much better, Matt. He's playing, he's playing a lot better.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson's confidence in the Seattle Seahawks
quotes.excerpt: I like the Seahawks. I just do. And it's not because of what I seen them do.
quotes.quote: I like the Seahawks. I just do. And it's not because of what I seen them do against Kansas City, I just, I don't know, I just feel like as long as they can run the football and the Bears' defense is not that good. We hype it up based on, you know, we remembered the 85 Bears, so we still living on that. No, that's all this real talk. You get caught in your mind, though, you just think defense bad. They, they, they run the ball, they play hard-nosed defense. I'm like, that defense is not good right now. And if Seattle can run the ball and Sam can keep it from turning it over, I don't see nobody in their secondary that can cover JSN right now.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson on Bam Adebayo's need to step up his game
quotes.excerpt: Bam went from 100 points to like absent 13. 12 and 7, shooting 40% and 16% from the three.
quotes.quote: Bam went from 100 points to like absent 13. 12 and 7, shooting 40% and 16% from the three. On the flip side, Giannis is 28, nine and five, shooting 55% from the field and 30% from the three. I was skeptical when they brought these together because not that they're similar players, but they are similar players. I think Giannis obviously is the far superior player and a superstar. I always thought, and I say this with all due respect, I always thought that Bam wasn't a number one option. I thought he would be a good second, second guy.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyshawn Johnson on the potential for a Bam Adebayo trade
quotes.excerpt: If it don't work out at a certain point and it start going a certain way.
quotes.quote: If it don't work out at a certain point and it start going a certain way. Let's say they're at the midway point and they're well under 500, I move Bam. Get some packages of picks and start it all over again. Because if you keep Giannis and and think about moving on from Bam, you could get some stuff, but is it enough? Is it enough? Where you say if I move on from Giannis, because we're not going to resign him, we're not going to give him $400 million and we're in neutral. If I move him, I know I'm going to get enough to rebuild the whole thing over.
